raw_text: Sikhs for Justice's latest referendum campaign is being amplified by an extensive bot network, according to social media analysts tracking the operation. The Quint's investigation found that over 60% of accounts using #KhalistanReferendum hashtags were created within 48 hours of the campaign launch. Indian intelligence agencies have flagged the campaign as a coordinated influence operation with suspected ISI backing.
